name: performance-audit
description: Analyze and identify performance bottlenecks across the full stack (Rust concurrency and memory, Tauri IPC, React rendering, SQLite queries), and generate a prioritized action plan report (P0-P2) with concrete Before/After code solutions. Use when asked to audit performance, investigate UI lag or freezes, optimize Rust async/locks or memory allocations, eliminate React re-render cascades, diagnose slow SQLite queries or IPC serialization overhead, or when user triggers: "성능상의 개선점 분석", "성능 감사", "성능 최적화", "병목 분석", "performance audit", "perf audit", "profile bottlenecks".
